## Dispatch — `domain:ui` PM seat (`os-tesla`), round R33

Claimed: objectstack-ai/objectui#9278 — dispatched to an `os-dev` seat by the `domain:ui` PM seat (`os-tesla`) at R33.
Clause-②: yes

### ⛔ The triage comment on this card is **BINDING** — read it in full first (rule 38)
It rules the direction, grades it, declares one **NOT MEASURED**, and — most importantly — resolves a **cross-card conflict** over a shared pin. Where it differs from anything below, it wins.

### ⭐ Premise re-verified at this seat before dispatch (rule 52)
Read on `origin/main` just now:

```
flow-node-config.ts:473   cfg('outcome', 'Outcome', 'text', { placeholder: 'success · failure' }),
FlowNodeInspector.declaredDefault.test.tsx:602   it('exactly ten fields declare a defaultValue, and these are they', …
UNDECLARED_REGISTER   → 0 hits across packages/
```

⇒ the defect line is verbatim; the shared pin still reads **ten**, so objectui#9277 has **not** landed; and objectui#9109's widening has **not** landed either — triage's readings all hold.

### The defect: one line, two faults
1. **The placeholder names two values the runtime refuses.** `EndConfigSchema.outcome` is an enum of exactly `completed | refused`, defaulting to `completed`. Neither `success` nor `failure` is in it.
2. **The control is `text`, not `select`** — an enum key offered as a free-text box, so the form neither constrains the value nor states the default the spec applies.

⭐ And the placeholder is not a neutral hint here: on a key with **no dropdown it is the only vocabulary the form offers**, so the author's most likely action is to type one of the two printed words — and the flow then **fails to load**. This is Commandment #0 one level down: **the values are part of the contract too.**

### ⚠️⚠️ THE CROSS-CARD CONFLICT — read this before you touch the pin
`FlowNodeInspector.declaredDefault.test.tsx:602` is an **exact-count** assertion, currently **ten**. Two cards move it:

| card | declarations added | the number that card wrote for itself |
|:--|--:|--:|
| objectui#9277 (`lockRecord` + `interrupting`) | 2 | 10 → **12** |
| **this card** (`end.outcome`) | 1 | 10 → **11** |

**Both are right in isolation.** Both landing ⇒ the truth is **13**, and whichever lands second meets a red pin it did not expect, or overwrites the other's count.

⇒ ⛔ **Do NOT write a target number into the implementation.** Compute it as **the pin's value at the moment you land, plus your own additions**, and **say in the PR body where you read the base from**. ⚠️ The "11" this card wrote for itself was computed assuming objectui#9277 does not exist — ⛔ do not copy it. (Right now the base reads **ten**, but re-read it: #9277 is unclaimed and could land first.)

### The acceptance
- `end.config.outcome` becomes a **`select`** whose options are the spec's two values (`completed` / `refused`), with `defaultValue: 'completed'` — ⭐ **derived from the installed spec**, per the `defaultValue` doc comment's rule.
- ⛔ Delete the `success · failure` placeholder.
- Pin count per the conflict rule above; ⛔ never hardcode 11.
- ⭐ **Ablation leg**: put the control back to `text`, or drop the `defaultValue` — the new assertion must redden.
- ⚠️ Per objectui#9273, a package-scoped run is not the blast radius: something rendered moves ⇒ look at `examples/schema-catalog/` and count-shaped prose figures.
- ⚠️ This change **brings `end` into objectui#9109's ledger scope** (that ledger covers every node type with a declaring field). ⭐ Measured just now: `UNDECLARED_REGISTER` is **0 hits**, so #9109's widening has **not** landed. ⇒ if it has landed by the time you get there, sync with it; ⛔ if it has not, **do not build it**.

### ⚠️ One thing triage did NOT measure, and you should
The spec side — `EndConfigSchema.outcome` as `completed | refused`, and `FlowNodeSchema` discriminating the `end` config through it — is **NOT MEASURED** by triage (`@objectstack/spec` was not installed in that container). The card supplies a reproducible probe **with a positive control in the same output** (`completed` ACCEPTED, so the two REJECTEDs are real refusals and not a dead probe). ⭐ **Run it yourself** and report which way it read; the whole repair derives its option list from that answer.

### Standing constraints for this round
- Read `AGENTS.md` in full before your first edit. ⛔ `packages/components/src/ui/**/*.tsx` is a **No-Touch zone** (Commandment #7).
- ⛔ Never skip, disable or quarantine a test. ⛔ Never force-push or rewrite pushed history.
- **Changeset required.** 41 packages in ONE `fixed` group ⇒ `major` unavailable; breaking ships as `minor` with a `**BREAKING**` carrier. Justify by **measurement** — an authoring control changes shape here.
- ⚠️ There is **no npm script matching `no-major`**; the file runs inside **`changeset:check`**. A `254 Command not found` on another spelling is **NOT MEASURED, not a red gate**.
- objectui has **no** `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs`; derive the gate family by hand from `package.json` + `.github/workflows/`.
- ⚠️⚠️ **A declared narrowing of your verification union can still be the load-bearing one.** This lane paid for it twice this session — a seat excluded `@object-ui/site` as "a docs app", but `apps/site` declares `type-check` **and** depends on the package under change, and CI went red exactly there. ⭐ Before trusting any exclusion, do a **membership read** of the dependent set plus a look at the excluded package's own `scripts`. (The objectui#9294 seat did this correctly this round and found `@object-ui/site` a **direct** dependent.)
- ⚠️ **Install/build first.** A missing `node_modules` makes every `require.resolve` fail identically — **instrument failure, not a negative answer**. Read verdicts from the verify-lock wrapper's VERDICT line, never a bare `$?`.
- ⚠️ **Carrier rule (directional):** hang `needs:contract-review` on **both** limbs in one stroke. ⛔ **Never clear either limb**; clearing is the PM's. (REST label POST needs `Content-Type: application/json`, else **415** — ⛔ not a permission failure.)
- ⚠️ **In flight:** objectui#9274 (p1) is in **`app-shell` inspectors too** — `ReportDefaultInspector.tsx`, a different file from yours, but ⛔ confirm rather than assume. Also objectui#9304 (`plugin-detail`, `plugin-form`), PR objectui#9326 (`plugin-grid`) and PR objectui#9310 (held).
- ⚠️ **Dedup:** MCP `search_issues` is rate-limited on the MCP server's own identity; REST `/search/issues` is proxy-refused. Paginate the repo-scoped open-issues list with a **known-hit control**; ⛔ no text query over CLOSED cards is possible — name that gap if it matters.
- ⛔ No model identifier in any pushed artifact; ⛔ don't copy a neighbouring commit's trailer — use the model-free form. ⛔ Card relations belong in the **PR body**, not the commit message.

### ⭐ The two instrument standards this seat holds
1. **Write the pin BEFORE the code** — the "unmodified" arm is then the real base tree.
2. **Every control must be able to fire.** ⭐ The card's own spec probe is the model: `completed` ACCEPTED in the **same output** as the two REJECTEDs is what makes those refusals a reading rather than a dead probe. Carry that shape into your own.
